info.name: WDP - MI-06B Repeated Inbound
info.description: Manual Customer and Facility Staff verification for MI-06B repeated receipts, canonical partial outbound, and MI-06D canonical relocation. Use disposable development/test data. New writes require their independent gates plus MI06_STOCK_LEDGER_WRITES_ENABLED=true. All new production writes remain forced OFF. Includes Staff partial confirmation, canonical REMOVE and MOVE movement checks. See MI_06B_POSTMAN.md and MI_06D_CANONICAL_RELOCATION.md.

item.name: Verify zero stock and cleared physical placement

request.description: Check onHandQuantity=0, heldQuantity=0 and currentCellId=null. Verify the allocation remains RESERVED only when no other stored Item occupies that Cell.

exec: const j=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Stock is depleted and unheld',()=>{pm.expect(j.data.onHandQuantity).to.equal(0);pm.expect(j.data.heldQuantity).to.equal(0);pm.expect(j.data.currentCellId).to.equal(null);});

item.name: MI-06 Canonical Relocation (manual Staff verification)
item.description: Requires disposable development/test data, gates enabled only outside production, and a canonical-compatible Item with positive stock and no holds. See MI_06D_CANONICAL_RELOCATION.md.

item.name: 1. Relocate full canonical stock A → B
item.description: Expected 200; saves movementId and unchanged current quantity.

exec: pm.test('relocation committed',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); const r=pm.response.json().data || pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('relocationMovementId',r.movement._id); pm.environment.set('relocationCurrentQty',r.currentQuantity); pm.test('whole stock moved',()=>pm.expect(r.movement.quantity).to.eql(r.currentQuantity));

item.name: 2. Verify Item currentCellId
item.description: Expected currentCellId = destinationCellId.

exec: pm.test('item read',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); const r=pm.response.json().data || pm.response.json(); pm.test('item is at destination',()=>pm.expect(String(r.currentCellId?._id || r.currentCellId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('destinationCellId')));

item.name: 3. Verify StockBalance placement and quantity
item.description: Expected currentCellId moves; onHand/held quantities stay unchanged.

exec: pm.test('balance read',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); const r=pm.response.json().data || pm.response.json(); pm.test('balance placement',()=>pm.expect(String(r.currentCellId?._id || r.currentCellId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('destinationCellId'))); pm.test('quantity unchanged',()=>pm.expect(r.onHandQuantity).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('relocationCurrentQty'))));

item.name: 4. Verify canonical MOVE movement and receipt batch lineage
item.description: Expected exactly one matching v2 RELOCATION movement with MOVE lines and receipt references.

exec: pm.test('movement history read',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); const raw=pm.response.json().data || pm.response.json(); const rows=Array.isArray(raw)?raw:(raw.movements||[]); const m=rows.find(x=>String(x._id)===pm.environment.get('relocationMovementId')); pm.test('canonical MOVE exists',()=>{pm.expect(m).to.exist;pm.expect(m.type).to.eql('RELOCATION');pm.expect(m.schemaVersion).to.eql(2);pm.expect(m.arithmeticPolicy).to.eql('CANONICAL_V1');pm.expect(m.batchLines.length).to.be.above(0);pm.expect(m.batchLines.every(x=>x.action==='MOVE'&&x.receiptMovementId)).to.eql(true);});

item.name: 5. Replay same relocation key safely
item.description: Expected idempotent replay of original committed movement, without another MOVE.

exec: pm.test('replay is success',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); const r=pm.response.json().data || pm.response.json(); pm.test('original movement replayed',()=>{pm.expect(r.idempotentReplay).to.eql(true);pm.expect(String(r.movement._id)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('relocationMovementId'));});

item.name: 9. Canonical partial outbound remains available after relocation

item.description: Verify movement-derived physical counters exposed by the Facility-scoped Warehouse Map DTO. Set expected source booking projection to OCCUPIED if another stored Item remains, otherwise RESERVED; destination must be OCCUPIED.
